quote: why don't we audit everyone who took those covid loans and make sure they actually qualified
rationale: Proposes that every recipient of the COVID loans be audited to confirm they qualified, and offers it as something bipartisan to take up before other legislation. Fires on the substitution test: the criterion's exemplars are filed disclosure and transparency statutes, and the subject's instance is a mandatory audit of an emergency public-money programme, which is the same class - an instrument that forces a public accounting of where public money went and returns it. Class met: remedy, plus the named class of recipient he says should not have qualified. +5 and no higher because the passage names no filed instrument, gives no mechanism for getting it a vote, and names nobody who prevented one.
